## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a valid Conventional Commit (it becomes the squash commit).
- [ ] Tests added or updated at the right level; `flutter test --exclude-tags golden` passes.
- [ ] `flutter analyze --fatal-infos` and the format check pass.
- [ ] Docs updated.
- [ ] Design tokens changed: `docs/design/design-system.md` updated in this PR.
- [ ] Strings added: ARB updated and localizations regenerated (`flutter gen-l10n`).
- [ ] Architectural change: an ADR is written or updated.
- [ ] Golden images changed: a reviewer has looked at the images.
- [ ] New dependency: justification added (purpose, alternatives, release date, license, native code, size).
